title: Prevent one denied GitHub owner-handoff from terminating unrelated Required recovery
root_cause: Original 5-minute Required Gate Watchdog throws for any PR-comment POST 403, aborting the entire PR scan even though some other current-head PRs need independent missing Required dispatch; root permission scope itself was already corrected by PR #4670.
impact: One denied PR owner comment blocks unrelated recovery and creates repeat incidents; a work queue may remain unreconciled.
fix: Catch only typed 401/403 on the exact PR comment POST, bound owner signal attempts, record immutable failed owner handoff, complete independent missing-run dispatch, then exit non-success. Preserve all original source/security gates.
prevention_rule: Partial recovery failure must be isolated to its precise side-effect but never silently converted to success; same canonical scheduler/owner, bounded attempts, immutable evidence and provider readback.
